beats.say: You expected silent alien dust, but a glowing arcade cabinet waits.
The uncharted planet hums without wind or life, leaving only your heavy boots on cold stone.
An ancient machine stands alone, powered by no source you recognize, screen flickering with your exact name in neon.
You press start and the retro display renders your suit, your landing ship and your exact mission in flawless pixel art.
Every jump you make, every rock you scan and every breath you take triggers a loud level up chime instantly.
The cabinet is not recording your progress: the planet itself is the game, and you just completed level one.
What would the first level of your own planet look like?
